en.text: They took out the Pigeon Lady!
Oh, that's not very nice, Bebop…
They took out the Chess Guy!
They took out the Test Pilot!
Nice to have someone take care of me for a change…
McGinnis, your timing is as good as ever…
I'm glad he's on our side…
Good lord that woman is a killing machine…
Hate to have to fight her…
How did she land that shot?
Infernus made short work of that…
You make arson look incredibly appealing…
Kelvin's keeping me in the fight….
Knew we could count on you, Lash…
They didn’t see you coming, Lash…
I'll be with you soon Mirage
You still have it, don't you, Talon…
You're an artist with that bow.
You ever want an honorary degree in Archery I can introduce you to people…
I don't know what we'd do without Talon…
Talon, there's a casserole with your name on it waiting for you when this is over…
Grey Talon's looking out for us…
They took out the Rat King!
It's always a pleasure to be on your team, Ivy…
If we keep working together they don't have a chance…
There goes one happy pile of goo
Now there goes a man with conviction…
I'll be back when I can Warden
Between the two of us we can keep their team locked down…
I don’t know how she does that..
And they thought they could escape Yamato…
That lady is definitely going to kill someone.
My abilities are ready to grow…
Perhaps it's time to work on my abilities…
Can't forget about improving my powers…
I should check in and see how the team is doing…
I don't like being exposed out here…
Well this is going great, I haven't seen an enemy in a while. Yep, haven't seen an enemy in a while… that’s… that's not good is it…
Marla would be worried sick if she knew what I was up to…
Just glad I was able to help!
I'm not going down without a fight.
I'm not leaving Marla a widow…
We have to make this count!
Glad I put a stop to that…
What does it take to stop this man?!
I'm gonna get punched, aren't I…
You'll have to try harder than that, Bebop…
And you thought you had the upper hand…
Tell me we have a plan…
They have the rejuv, be careful…
Geist is on the hunt nearby…
Don't let Geist steal your health!
Find a place to hide from the storm cloud!
You can't hide from me, Haze!
You can run but it won't be enough…
And she thought she could escape us…
Vindicta's trying to take me out…
I need to hide from their sniper…
Couldn't let her keep flying around like that….
Whew, that could have gone poorly…
We need to keep Shiv from healing!
So this is what it feels like…
I'm doing rather well, aren't I…
Just need to keep this up…
I can't let you stop us!
My friends don't appreciate being dragged around by you…
Hope he didn't have any friends on the force…
That was a very large man…
Can't believe I took down Abrams…
Took care of the scrap golem!
I am going to feel terrible about that tomorrow.
That young lady has a promising future, but a horrible today.
I'm surprised someone as nice as her is helping them.
Took care of the Time Thief!
She made me work for that…
Well that was a very polite albeit intimidating young man.
I am terrified and fascinated by him in equal measure.
I think I’ll be skipping the faculty luncheon at The Baroness this year.
I would love to talk to you later, Rem.
I’m sorry I couldn’t help you, Rem.
They’re taking advantage of you, Rem.
I need to have words with those teachers at Blackmore.
I feel like that may have repercussions.
McGinnis you are letting a brilliant mind go to waste…
Never was a fan of the Occult Industrial Complex…
Did Fairfax put you up to this, McGinnis?
Yours is a curious condition, Victor, I'm sorry that I can't help you.
I hope you find what you're looking for, Victor, but I can't let you stop me.
The world's a little safer without you in it, Geist…
She'll be back, and she'll be pissed…
That's one way to deal with the Oathkeeper problem…
I've never seen power like his…
He's even more terrifying than I thought…
Got some breathing room from Seven…
She's probably going to want revenge isn't she…
My students will not believe that I took out a Sandman.
And now I've picked a fight with the OSIC… great.
When I got into education I did not expect to be fighting the us government.
For a minute there I thought Marla was going to be a widow…
The ends never justify the means, Vindicta…
You can't change hearts and minds with a bullet, Vindicta…
Not a fan of being immolated…
And that my friends, is how we snuff out a fire.
I hope my jacket isn't singed too badly…
Kelvin, you are a man after my own heart, and I am so sorry I had to do that…
It's an awkward time to say this, Kelvin, but I love your book.
Even when he's fighting you, that guy is just so classy…
Best of luck next time, Kelvin.
That was one big mole guy.
A little humility would do you good, Lash.
Pride always comes before the fall, Lash.
Lash: you need to learn to be a little nicer.
I've had my body tampered with enough, thank you very much.
Sinclair, you don't need the Patrons, you need marriage counseling.
You know, I hope those two will work it out sometime.
Mirage is tough to bring down…
Sorry, Calico, I promised Marla I'd come home safe.
A world class assassin tried to kill me, I am simultaneously flattered and horrified.
Good god, is that a lich hand?
High school has changed a lot from when I was a teenager.
What the hell are they teaching at Blackmore.
Don’t play with the dead, Graves.
Vengeance will only get you so far, Grey Talon…
That could have gone very poorly…
That man would burn down this city if it got him what he wanted.
He’s no man of god, he’s a maniac.
You can’t reason with someone like him.
Being angry isn’t the same thing as being interesting.
His parents really let him down.
I hope the Baxter Society doesn’t take this personally…
I admire what the Baxter Society does but I can't let you stop me…
Shiv won't be bothering us for a while…
a classic example of style over substance…
They couldn't hide in that case forever…
You should audit my class sometime, pocket…
I'm telling the class all about that on Monday.
I'll be sure to give my condolences to Sophia, Ivy…
I assure you, Ivy, your behavior will not impact my grading of Sophia Arroyo.
I killed a unicorn and I feel terrible about it.
Well, at least she had a positive attitude.
Mina, you don’t know as much as you think you do.
That young lady is casually cruel.
Hope none of my students end up like her.
Some people just make poor life choices.
And now I understand why our recidivism rate is so high.
I think I'll leave that part out when I tell Marla about my day.
That is something you don't see every day…
Goo washes out of tweed, right?
Your crusade comes to an end here!
Silver, it’s not too late for you to make better choices.
I’m glad I still have all my extremities.
One less crime lord to deal with…
Didn't expect to deal with a telekinetic mobster today…
Stay away from my students, Wraith.
The students are not gonna believe me when I talk about my day…
Is this what the future of war looks like?
The 7th Moon will never take root in New York…
New York has enough crime lords thank you very much…
That woman was really invested in stabbing people…
I think the class would be impressed. Or terrified. Probably terrified.
No one will stop me from getting my body back!
Let's see the provost cut funding now…
I feel like I can do anything!
I am surprisingly good at killing people…
Alright I think I'm getting the hang of this…
Oooooo everyone's dead but me that's bad.
OK, just breathe…I'll be fine, what's the worst that could happen, they kill me? Ok that sounds pretty bad….
And back into the field we go…
I need to step away, good luck.
We tried our best… sometimes that's just not enough.
There will be another eclipse… perhaps sooner than you think.
Anyone can have an off day…
No one is perfect, we just need to try again…
Not exactly how I pictured this ending…
Who wants to eat their feelings with me?
Look, sometimes things don't go our way, it happens…
Set backs happen all the time, let's just try again…
Failure happens in life… just ask my students after finals
It's ok…I've… I've grown used to this body. I can wait another 50 years…
That could have gone either way…
We did our best, no shame in that.
I need to find a place to heal….
Mr. Abrams, if you think this is the first fight I've been in you've never played pinochle in Bristol.
Detective, I was about to say the same thing to you.
I don't suppose I could take a look at that tome when all of this is over.
I heard a rumor that you were in with Lady Geist.
Who would have thought that a simple business card could start a star-crossed romance
No apologies needed. Wasn't my party. Did you ever meet up with Lady Geist?
Oh, I wasn't made - my body just was obliterated by an astral gate.
Listen, we're both just a couple floating souls in iron bodies I think there's plenty of common ground.
Bebop; you are gentleman and I appreciate you.
You know you seem remarkably polite for a pit fighter.
Well she should be proud of her son
You seem like an upstanding young lady.
Well I am relieved to be paired up with you and not some psychotic killing machine.
It is a marvelous retreat filled with scintillating conversations, apocryphal information, and the best wine across the planes.
I hope you get to see it someday, it's pretty great.
I think it's wonderful you use your gift to show children the power of stories.
Indeed! I figure getting my body back is the best thing I could give her.
I just wanted to let you know, that when I could still eat food one of my favorite places to go was Sunday brunch at The Baroness.
Not having a face helps hide the terror.
When I open the black hole, I'll be exposed.
I'll help satiate your hunger drifter.
No! Jesus, I'll heal you in combat.
I'm glad you're here sheriff, if The Troubadour is in New York - the city is going to need your expertise.
Sheriff I do my best to be precise but sometimes even I miscalculate the area of a blackhole. If you would be so kind-
I read about what happened in Macomb. Absolutely ghoulish.
Understandable. I just - I just hope you catch whoever's responsible.
So how does time manipulation work?
I am absolutely fascinated by your organization Paradox
I took Marla to the last pop-up, truly wonderful things to behold.
Can I ask you a question?
Why do keep stealing things? Don't you have enough?
I appreciate the offer Miss McGinnis, but hopefully after today your services won't be needed.
Have you ever considered being an adjunct professor?
Good god, you'd be the Lash of academia.
Oh no, why do you ask?
Not sure what to do with that
I'll see what I can do.
That binding ward is looking in rough shape
I would have that looked at soon.
Yes. And very patient. hopefully after the ritual that patience will be rewarded.
Pleasure to see you again, Lady Geist.
Thank you for the funding. I trust that your own keeper situation has been resolved.

Well, it's clear that the Patrons are beings of immense power. Whether or not they actually intend to fulfill their end of the bargain is less about science and more about their nature. On the plus side, we're about to find out.
Easy words to say when you've never loved someone.
I am flattered and horrified in equal measure
I'm sure it's a touchy subject, but I simply must know how you stopped your soul from being obliterated
Many things are, but if I let that stop me from trying to learn I wouldn't be.. Well I probably would still have my body.
For a moment I thought you said Marla and I got terribly confused.
I'm quite happy in the private sector.
So you're in the Sandman Division.
Are there a lot of you?
Once I open the blackhole I'm going to be pretty exposed.
I'm not worried about you capitalizing on the opportunity, I'm worried about dying in the process.
That sound's rather ominous and I'm ok not asking questions
You know I have a friend in the history department that would be over the moon if he got to meet you
You are not and I am sorry to offend you.
May I ask a favor Infernus?
I was thinking of buying a hat and I would love it if you'd join me at the haberdashery.
Well, you've been a little busy being dead.
It's great to see you again Kelvin.
Today will be a day to remember, my friend.
Well, I'm hoping my body. But if not, I've got an eye on some books.
You know what, actually I do think there is someone I can talk to
Mo. Krill. If we get our timing down I am confident that we can make their lives a living hell.
And I'll try not to drop a black hole on someone you grabbed.
Gentlemen, you're both well connected individuals right?
My anniversary is coming up and I was really hoping to get Marla something special.
She's a big reader so I was thinking a rare book.
I would be very excited, then remind you that I have a teacher's salary.
I'm shocked you know what an adjunct is.
Don't talk about Marla like that.
And I'm just telling you to respect my wife.
I believe you mean "The Patron", but to answer your question: give Marla a hug and not let go for about 3 months.
I have wanted to speak to a djinn for quite some time, I imagine they are a fascinating people.
It’s a fancy way of saying boring.
What's your favorite part of New York that you've seen?
One of my favorite places to go think.
It was either that or give into despair, and that's not really an option is it?
I won't lie - after what happened to my body I decided to stay clear of Astral Gates, but I hear that South Ixia is beautiful.
Maybe when this is over we could takes the wives on a couples trip.
If you think academics lack willpower you are sorely mistaken.
Stay close to me Shiv, I'll do my best to keep you in the fight
After the ritual, I don't suppose I could take a look at that case?
While disappointed, I respect your decision.
These days "friends" might be pushing it, but I'd say he has warm nostalgia for me
He's a complicated man. There's a difference.
You should have told me you were alive, Arin.
I'm your godfather, I would have helped you.
Well at least I'm here now.
That's kind of you to say.
Ok-ish. She's a great student, but lately she's been falling asleep in class. She says she's been pulling long shifts at her job and it's wearing her out.
Well, if you could talk to her I think it'd do a world of good
So Ivy, how long have you been a vigilante.
Well, if we survive and you need a reference, let me know.
Well aren't you a fascinating creature…
When the ritual is over I'd love to pick your brain.
Oh! It's an expression, it means to ask questions.
Indeed, but I've found a positive outlook makes all the difference.
I appreciate the sentiment Warden, but don't worry about me: I'll be beside you, not behind you.
Warden, I wanted to put your mind at ease; I'm not just a man of science, but a man of action.
I couldn't help but overhear one of my students mention that she frequents your establishment.
Indeed they do. They also don't have fully formed brains, and if I find out you are taking advantage of that I will it take it personally.
Marla and I have been known to make bridge night a little more interesting.
I prefer working with people, not lying to them.
So yes. Anyway: a professional question for you -
In your line of work do people end up dead
Then close enough. The point is if I hold someone in a black hole are you ok with shooting them.
Coming from you, I'll take that as a compliment.
Forgive me, I don't speak war criminal.
I wonder why the patron put us together.
Well now you hurt my feelings.
Why hello there, I'm professor Dynamo.
I have so many questions for you Rem.
There's no such thing as stupid questions.
The sky is not made of peanut butter, while technically possible a desk made solely out of pillows would not be structurally sound, and 1/2 the base times the height.
In college we don't have class pets.
I imagine everyone would be less cranky if they did, Rem.
You're in high school - shouldn't you worry about prom not how connected your classmates are?
So are you pragmatic or a sociopath?
I'd like to think I am.
Well this is a pleasant surprise -most teenagers I've met think they know everything.
Then stay close to me…I think you'll pick up a thing or two.
When I pick them up in a black hole, that's your chance to finish them off
I agree, but the stakes are too high.
Not a problem - nothing makes my life harder than people running away from the fight
Oh VP and S is one of the oldest medical schools in the country.
This conversation has taken a turn.
Ya know, I have never had a need to find out but assuming we survive the ritual I would be happy to ask.
OK, well let's not do that. How about I try to stay close to you so you can stay on your feet.
Well that's rather unnerving now isn't it?
Why do you know my wife's name.
Don't tell me what I need to worry about.
Calico is a fairly unique name
That…. That pretty much covers everything.
Fair enough, but if you ever change your mind I have a great one ready to go.
I didn't think Blackmore was on break.
Have you given any thought to college?
Why not go to law school, you can always do necromancy as a hobby.
You know Father, I believe I spoke with one of your colleagues a few years ago at The Black Chateau.
Well I hope that ends well for him.
Father, one of my colleagues at Columbia was looking to find a guest speaker for his unit on Faustian Bargains. Would you be willing to give him a call?
And I will be happy to return the favor, Venator.

Me being smarter than you has nothing to do about where I teach. But to be clear, just because I have progressed more academically, doesn’t mean that I have more common sense than you, as evidenced by my current condition.
Billy, I'm saying I'm smarter, not better. But if you want to have a math off, I'm sure that I can get someone to proctor it.
I look like someone who can’t drink at all.
Stay close to me Celeste, I'll keep you safe
I'm sure she would say that.
It's been years. She deserves a husband with a heart she can feel and a face she can see light up when she walks in the room.
Some definitely appear more welcoming than others.
Because some things are more important than money.
Mina, one of my colleagues has a course on The Vampire Nation, I don't suppose I could put you two in touch.
I didn’t think you'd be interested in metaphysics
It's not too late to turn your life around Vyper.
Marla made me one for our anniversary.
I can't tell if you're saying that as a compliment or an insult.
Oh, I didn’t mean to be rude…
Well, if I loved it, I probably wouldn’t be here risking my life.
I'm going to assume that's a compliment
Forgive my ignorance Yamato, but is that sword an heirloom?
I hope I didn't rip my jacket again, Marla just sewed it…
This takes me back to undergrad..
Excuse me, could you come back please?
Where's the rest of my team?
I can't do this on my own!
Oh dear, that's a lot of them…
Gotta be smart in how I handle this…
The math here is bad for me..
You think I've never been in a fist fight before?
Well isn't this a nice little per diem…
Educators are not paid nearly enough
We got the rejuv, what's next?
I'm not gonna let you push me around!
Looks like I'll have to cancel class this afternoon…
Oh I wouldn't miss this for the world…
One day, my body will be returned to me…
Let me collect my extremities and I'll be right there.
Well then, it looks like we have work to do…
And here I was thinking I would be reviewing term papers all day…
Time for a little field work.
Oh this is going to be exciting!
I think a little shopping is in order…
Might be time to get something.
Maybe I should invest in myself…
Wonder what they have at the store.
This money won't help unless I spend it…
It's time to get more supplies…
No point in saving any more money…
Gotta put these souls to good use.
The ritual is one step closer…
We got the objective and that's all that matters.
They're not going to be too happy about that…
Whew, I was worried I'd miss the faculty meeting…
Be careful, strange things are afoot.
Sorry I can't join you, maybe next time..
Maybe I'll see you in the field.
I'm going to take that no as a strong maybe.
I wish I could help, but I'm downing in term papers.
I'll need to be ready to defend myself…
Marla always did warn me about my temper…
I don't like to show this side of me, but it would seem I have no choice…
I can't let them stop me…
They'll walk all over me if I let them, I need to be firm.
I'm ready to take a stand…
This will put them on their heels…
The stakes are too high, I need to be willing to finish them off…
Only a fool relies on a gun instead of science.
My condition has a few perks…
This is about to get exciting…
Time for a lesson in displacement…
It can be a bit disorienting, but it's better than being dead.
Hm, I should cover this in my wormhole unit.
Who's ready for some quantum shenanigans?
Hope my colleagues are ready for this….
Ready to fold space and time.
Marla's right… I do lead a strange life.
It's a simple matter of translocation.
Time this right and I can get out of anything…
My allies are capable, but a little help never hurts.
I'm here to support the team…
The big bang wasn't just an explosion… it created life. I shall do the same…
My team will be safe with me…
People don't need to understand why this works, they just need to be excited that it works…
Who's to say where science ends and magic begins…
I'll support people anyway I can…
I thought my condition a curse, but I've learned how to use it to help people…
I'll help my friends the best I can…
If we don't survive the Ritual, all of this will be for nothing.
My team is counting on me.
I won't let the team down…
One black hole can make all the difference…
And my students think theoretical metaphysics have no practical applications…
When I use this I need to make sure my team's ready…
I can't wait for my colleagues to hear about this…
I'll lock down their whole team…
Ready to drop another black hole.
They can shoot me all they want!
I'll hold them as long as I can!
I have a gift for you!
If that doesn't justify my tenure, what does…
Looks like I'll be able to meet Marla for dinner after all…
I couldn't imagine that going any better…
See what a positive attitude and a neigh limitless supply of ammunition can do?
And like that, the ritual is concluded…
Who was worried, I wasn't worried.
We weren't just a team…we were a family…
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
I need to step away, good luck.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
It was nice meeting you all, but I have papers to grade…
I think today is going to be a great opportunity for personal growth.
Who wants to summon an elder god?
Good luck, everyone. Well. Not everyone. I want them to lose.

Anyone else nervous? I'm not. Why would I be? Who could possibly be nervous when they think about the ramifications of what we're about to do. The fact that we are about to stare death - no - a god- in the face and see if he blinks first. I'm fine.
I don't want to get you all too excited, but Marla gave me one of her famous key lime pies to share after we win.
Well I, for one, am terribly excited to see what happens next.
Lash is here, keep your wits about you.
Shiv's here, we can't let him claim trophies
There's a walking goo pile here
I can drop a black hole whenever.
I got a Black Hole for next team fight.
Ready to unleash a black hole.
